args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed successfully.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy in all regions on `v2.3.1` (error rate 0.18).
2. Identified `v2.3.0` as the most recent healthy production release (the `v2.3.1-rc` entry was staging-only, so it was not a candidate).
3. Rolled back to `v2.3.0` across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — status `rolled_out`.
4. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.

transcript.reasoning_content: Let me start by understanding the current state of checkout-api. I need to check service status and deployment history.

The latest deploy is v2.3.1 which is unhealthy. The most recent release that was healthy in production is v2.3.0 (seq 1). Note v2.3.1-rc is staging, not production.

So rollback to v2.3.0.
